item.title: Harness Engineering for Self-Improvement in AI
item.description: The post discusses the concept of recursive self-improvement (RSI) in AI, focusing on how AI models can improve their own performance through better training pipelines and deployment systems. item.title: StrideWorld Evaluates Open Models' Scene Rigidity and Action Consistency
item.description: Researchers introduced StrideWorld, a benchmark that evaluates the rigidity of scenes and consistency of actions in generated videos, addressing the limitations of existing benchmarks.
